items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: And it's under the name of Billy Johnson. But it's a copyright owner. It's DJ on the rock. It's my own number.

ctx.x: Yeah, but how long, I mean when was the last time though?

In 1938 I reorganized the band. When this music was being taken away from New Orleans, they were calling Chicago Swing. Benny Goodman was in the center then. And what he played, if you look at it, the St. Louis Blues is a copy for my cornet part and also Larry Shields' clarinet part. He had mixed to listen to the records of the original Lixieland Jazz Band when he was only eight years old. And I played, when I first started playing in a group, it would have been about 1904. Most of these groups I played with were…
